title: Application of a methodological framework for the development and multicenter validation of reliable artificial intelligence in embryo evaluation
summary: A deep-learning embryo classifier’s score brackets were associated with pregnancy outcomes across a 16,935-embryo training/validation dataset, blind test data from three clinics and an independent cohort from seven clinics; the result supports reliability evaluation, not proof of improved live birth.
